facts.fact: On 11 November 2026 President Traoré launched mass enrolment in the register of the electronic unique identifier, issuing a free random 12-digit number per person, through 160 enrolment sites and mobile teams.
The Presidency's release says enrolment collects photograph, fingerprints and iris data to eliminate multiple records, so each person holds a single number.

systems.owner: Ministry in charge of digital transition

note: No certification, audit or assurance level stated, and no population share enrolled.
